device.description: 8-bit 10-200 MSPS pipelined ADC with parallel CMOS outputs and power-down
device.note: adc08200.pdf (SNAS136M) p.2 pin configuration (Figure 1), p.3 pin descriptions, p.4 operating ratings, p.5 CLK/PD input characteristics, p.7 AC characteristics (tOD, pipeline delay), p.15 functional description (straight binary, PD)

pages: p.2 (Figure 1 pinout: D7..D4 on 13-16, D3..D0 on 19-22), p.3 (pin descriptions; pin 18 is VDR), p.4 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-3.6 V, VDR 2.4 V to VA), p.7 (fC 10-200 MHz, tOD 5.1 ns max, pipeline delay 6 clocks), p.15 (data acquired on CLK rising, outputs 6 clocks + tOD later; straight binary; PD high = power down, outputs hold the last result)
notModeled: analog input and reference ladder VRT/VRM/VRB (the result is always the 0 V code 0x00, an input at or below VRB)
pipeline latency of 6 clock cycles (the code is constant); output hold time tOH
conversion rate limits (10-200 MHz) and minimum clock high/low times
outputs hold the last code while PD is high (the model's powerdown pin only blocks conversions)
CLK and PD are referenced to VA (2.7-3.6 V), the outputs to VDR (2.4 V to VA); vcc is the VDR range
pin 18 is named VDR in the pin table (DR VD in the block diagram)
